s: strI, (mugDa + wAp .) nAyikAviSezaH । (sA ca nAyikA svIyAparakIyABedena dviviDA .) tatra svIyApi triviDA । mugDA maDyA pragalBA ca । tatrANkuritayOvanA mugDA । sA ca jYAtayOvanA ajYAtayOvanA ca । sEva kramaSo lajjABayaparADInaratirnavoQA । sEva jAtapraSrayA viSrabDanavoQA । asyAScezwA kriyA manoharA । kope mArddavaM navaviBUzaRe samIhA ca ॥ mugDA yaTA । “AjYaptaM kila kAmadevaDaraRIpAlena kAle SuBe vastuM vAstuviDiM viDAsyati tanO tAruRyameRIdfSaH । dfzwyA KaYjanacAturI muKarucA sODAkarI mADurI vAcA kiYca suDAsamudralaharI lAzaRyamAmantryate ॥” * ॥ ajYAtayOvanA yaTA, -- “nIrAttIramupAgatA SravaRayoH sImni sPurannetrayoH Srotre lagnamidaM kimutpalamiti jYAtuM karaMnyasyati । SEbAlANkuraSaNkayA SaSimuKI romAvalIM proYCati SrAntAsmAti muhuH saKImaviditaSroRIBarA pfcCati ॥” jYAtayOvanA yaTA, -- “svayamBUH SamBuramBojalocane tvatpayoDaraH । naKena kasya Danyasya candracUqo Bavizyati ॥” navoQA yaTA, -- “haste DftApi Sayane viniveSitApi kroqe kftApi yatate bahireva gantum । jAnImahe navabaDUraTa tasya vaSyA yaH pAradaM sTirayituM kzamate kareRa ॥” dvitIyA yaTA, -- “balAnnItA pArSvaM muKamanumuKaM nEva kurute DunAnA mUrdDAnaM kzipati vadanaM cumbanaviDO । hfdi nyastaM hastaM kzipati gamanAropitamanA navoQA voQAraM ramayati ca santApayati ca ॥” viSrabDanavoQA yaTA, -- “daramukulitanetrapAlinIvIniyamitabAhukftoruyugmabanDam । karakalitakucasTalaM navoQA svapiti samIpamupetya kasya yUnaH ॥” iti rasamaYjarI ॥

m: मुग्धा-चक्र n. a partic. mystical circle, Cat.
मुग्धाग्रणी m. the chief of fools, Kathās.
मुग्धाक्षी f. a fair-eyed woman, Kāv.; Kathās.
मुग्धालोक mfn. lovely to look at, Uttarar.
मुग्धानन mfn. lovely-faced, W.
मुग्धात्मन् mfn. foolish, ignorant, Kāv.

m: मुग्ध &c. See p. 825, col. 1.
मुग्ध mfn. gone astray, lost, RV.; VS.
perplexed, bewildered, AV.; Daś.
foolish, ignorant, silly, ŚBr. &c. &c.

inexperienced, simple, innocent, artless, attractive or charming (from youthfulness), lovely, beautiful, tender, young (esp. आ f. a young and beautiful female, often in voc.; also in rhet. a variety of the Nāyikā), Kāv.; Kathās.; Rājat.
(ifc.) strikingly like, Vcar.; Bālar.
a: मुग्ध — a. [मुह्-क्त] 1 Stupefied. fainted. --2 Perplexed, infatuated. --3 Foolish, ignorant, silly, stupid; शशांक केन मुग्धेन सुधांशुरिति भाषितः Bv. 2. 29; अयि मुग्धे कान्या चिंता प्रियास्तमागमस्य V. 3. --4 Simple, artless, innocent; U. 1. 46; Māl. 7. 1. --5 Erring, mistaken. --6 Attractive by youthful simplicity (not yet acquainted with love), child-like; (कः) अयमाचरत्यविनयं मुग्धासु तपस्विकन्यासु Ś. 1. 25; U. 6. 35; R. 9. 34. --7 (Hence) Beautiful, lovely, charming, pretty; हरिरिह मुग्धवधूनिकरे विलासिनि विलसति केलिपरे Gīt. 1; U. 3. 5. --ग्धा A young girl attractive by her youthful simplicity, a pretty young maiden; (regarded as a variety of Nāyikā in poetic compositions). --Comp. --अक्षी a lovely-eyed woman; वियोगो मुग्धाक्ष्याः स खलु रिपुघातावधिरभूत् U. 3. 44. --आनना having a lovely face. --आलोक a. lovely to look at; U. 1. 20. --धी, --बुद्धि, --मति a. silly, foolish, stupid, simple. --भावः simplicity, silliness.

m: मुग्ध—भाव m. stupidity, simplicity, BhP.
मुग्ध—धी mfn. foolish, silly, a simpleton, Kathās.
मुग्ध—बो˚धाख्या ज्वरादि-रोग-चिकित्सा f. N. of a medical wk.

s: klI, (mugDaH sundaraH boDaH jYAnaM padapadArTAnAM BavatyasmAt । yadbA, mugDAn mUQAn alpabudDIn janAn boDayatIti । mugDaboDam । iti durgAdAsaH । mugDa + buD + “karmmaRyaR । 3 । 2 । 1 । iti aR .) vopadevakftavyAkaraRaviSezaH । yaTAsyAdyaSlokaH । “mukundaM saccidAnandaM praRipatya praRIyate । mugDaboDaM vyAkaraRaM paropakftaye mayA ॥”
m: मुग्ध—बोध n. (scil. व्याकरण) ‘instructing the ignorant’, N. of a celebrated grammar by Vopa-deva (supposed to have flourished in the 13th century, and regarded as a great authority in Bengal)
of another wk. (on the consecration of new houses)
मुग्ध—बोध—कार m. N. of Vopadeva, Cat.
मुग्ध—बोध—परिशिष्ट n. N. of wk. connected with Vop˚'s grammar
मुग्ध—बोध—प्रदीप m. N. of wk. connected with Vop˚'s grammar
मुग्ध—बोध—सुबोधिनी f. N. of wk. connected with Vop˚'s grammar
मुग्ध—बोधिनी f. (scil. टीका) N. of 2 Comms., on the Amara-koṣa and the Bhaṭṭi-kāvya by Bharatasena.
मुग्ध—बुद्धि mfn. = -धी, Kathās.
मुग्ध—दूर्वा f. young or tender Dūrvā grass, Śak.
मुग्ध—दृश् mfn. fair-eyed, Sāh.
मुग्ध—द्वीप m. N. of an island, Uttamac.
मुग्ध—गण्ड-फलक mfn. (a face compared to a young lotus) whose pericarps are lovely cheeks, ib.
मुग्ध—हरिणी f. a young or tender antelope, Bhartṛ.
मुग्ध—कान्ता-स्तन m. the bosom of a young mistress, Śiś.
मुग्ध—कथा f. a tale about a fool, MW.
मुग्ध—मति mfn. = धी, A.
मुग्ध—मृग m. a young or harmless deer, Śāntiś.
मुग्ध—प्रबोध m. instruction of the ignorant (only in ˚धे गृह-प्रवेश-विधि m. N. of wk.).
मुग्ध—स्वभाव m. artlessness, simplicity, Veṇīs.
मुग्ध—स्वभाव mfn. artless or charming by nature, Pañcat.
मुग्ध—ता n.
a: मुग्धता --त्वं — 1 Silliness. --2 Artlessness, simplicity. --3 Loveliness, charmingness.

m: मुग्ध—त्व n. ignorance, simplicity artlessness, loveliness, Kāv.
मुग्ध—वधू f. a young and lovely woman, Ragh.
मुग्ध—वत् mfn. perplexed, embarrassed, ignorant of or inexperienced in (loc.), MBh.
मुग्ध—विलोकित n. a beautiful glance
मुग्ध—विल्˚ओपितोपदेश m. instruction in b˚ glances, Śak.
मुग्धेक्षणा f. = मुग्धाक्षी, Priy.
मुग्धेन्दु m. the new moon, Kāv.
मुग्धिमन् m. ignorance, simplicity, artlessness, Vām. v, 2, 56 (v.l.)
मुगूह m. a species of gallinule (= दात्यूह), L.
मुगदस, मुगदेमु, मुगल-स्थान, N. of places, Cat.
